default.description: No secrets, no cluster access; internet, DNS and pi-sync only.

operator.description: Infra only: cluster-admin, ghcr + platform secrets via operator-env (mise run selfhost:platform:pi-ez-operator:env:apply), open egress.

labrat.description: labrat only: an OpenShell sandbox with Claude through the gateway and read-only cluster access through the labrat-kube relay. No GitHub, no secrets, no other network.

pi-web-developer.description: Role pi-web/pi-web-developer for role_agent calls from the pi-web-ecosystem project: an OpenShell sandbox with Claude through the gateway, GitHub as the role's bot through gateway provider pi-web-developer-github (which must exist first: clone, push and the API for the pi-* repos), the npm registry, and the Go toolchain and module hosts. To check what it deployed, it reads (GET only, cluster-wide view-only RBAC, no Secrets) through the shared labrat-kube relay (kubectl, KUBERNETES_MASTER), plus Prometheus and Loki (PROMETHEUS_URL, LOKI_URL). No other network, no secrets, no cluster credential.
